global_degradations: An absent host is skipped by --auto and reported as terminal_fallback/degraded; it is not claimed as installed.
Host session-card surfaces are provided through each host's configured consumer; they are not native desktop panels.
No default resident daemon, web dashboard, telemetry, or network listener exists; the dispatcher and TUI exit when idle.
Snooze is durable and due-time gated, but without a resident scheduler it is re-dispatched on the next bridge activity after the due time.
Windows native notification is x86-64 only in 2.0.0; ARM64 is not claimed.
The final release must rebuild and Authenticode-sign the Windows helper because the local host lacked the MSVC linker.
macOS native-notification, signing, Gatekeeper, notarization, Intel, and Apple Silicon acceptance remain pending CI/real-machine evidence.
